channel.title: ResponderTX · Flood Ops
channel.description: Flood warnings, watches and advisories, flash flood emergencies, forecast river crests, and active notices for Texas. Situational awareness, not a dispatch system; call 911 for emergencies.

item.title: Flood Watch · La Salle, McMullen, Live Oak, Bee, Goliad, Webb and 14 more
item.description: Flood Watch issued November 6 at 8:17PM CST until November 9 at 12:00PM CST by NWS Corpus Christi TX. In effect until Nov 9, 12:00 PM CT. Areas: La Salle, McMullen, Live Oak, Bee, Goliad, Webb, Duval, Jim Wells, Inland Kleberg, Inland Nueces, Inland San Patricio, Coastal Aransas, Inland Refugio, Coastal Kleberg, Coastal Nueces, Coastal San Patricio, Aransas Islands, Coastal Refugio, Kleberg Islands, Nueces Islands. Source: National Weather Service. Call 911 for life-threatening emergencies.
